name: 0xRajeev
description: Rajeev is the founder of Secureum where he dedicates his time to scaling Ethereum security, after having spent >25 years doing security research. He is a Cantina Fellow & Lead Security Researcher at Spearbit, and has previously collaborated with Trail of Bits (as one of the leading contributors to Slither). He has a PhD in CS, with a focus on cybersecurity, from Purdue University, USA. He spent seven years at Intel USA as a security architect and strategist.
